options.why: States the function value $y = 5$ at $x = 2$ instead of finding the tangent slope.
Divides $y = 5$ by $x = 2$ ($5 \div 2 = 2.5$) instead of computing the tangent gradient.
Averages the coordinates of the tangent point $(4,9)$ together with the tangency point $(2,5)$ incorrectly as $(9+5+4)\div3=6$, instead of finding rise over run.
Omits the negative sign; because the volume is decreasing over time, the rate of change of volume is negative.
Calculates the total change in volume $12 - 60 = -48\text{ L}$ without dividing by the elapsed time of $8\text{ min}$.
Divides the volume $V(4) = 36\text{ L}$ by $4\text{ min}$ with a negative sign instead of finding the gradient of the tangent line.
Uses the drawn rise of $4$ grid squares and run of $4$ grid squares without allowing for the vertical scale of $5$ units per square.
States the function value at $x=2$ instead of the tangent gradient.
Finds the tangent's rise $22-2=20$ but does not divide by the run of $4$.
States the function value $f(3)=7$ instead of the tangent gradient.
Calculates the rise $13-1=12$ without dividing by the run $5-1=4$.
Reverses only the vertical subtraction, using $(1-13)\div(5-1)=-3$.
Calculates the distance change $63 - 15 = 48\text{ m}$ without dividing by time $6\text{ s}$.
Divides the distance at the tangency point by its time, $39\div6=6.5$, instead of finding the tangent gradient.
Divides $63$ by $6\text{ s}$ instead of using the two points on the tangent line.
Divides coordinate $y = 3$ by $x = 2$ ($3 \div 2 = 1.5$) instead of computing tangent gradient.
States the $y$-value at the point of tangency instead of the gradient.
States the rise between $(0, -5)$ and $(3, 7)$ without dividing by the run of $3$.
Calculates the height change $24 - 6 = 18\text{ cm}$ without dividing by the $6\text{-day}$ interval.
Divides $24$ by $5\text{ days}$ instead of using the points on the tangent line.
Divides the height change by twice the correct time interval, $(24-6)\div(2(8-2))=1.5$.
Divides the tangency point's coordinates, $7\div2=3.5$, instead of finding the tangent gradient.
States the function value $f(2)=7$ instead of the instantaneous rate of change.
Divides $13-1=12$ by $2$ instead of the run $4-0=4$.
